initiatives.name: Really Really Free Market Albany
initiatives.description: Free market in Albany that holds events at Hackleman Park where people drop off and take clothes, food and other necessities with no money or trading.

initiatives.name: Stop the Sweeps CV
initiatives.description: Small mutual aid group in Corvallis that supports unhoused neighbors with supplies, meals and help during camp sweeps, and advocates against sweeps.

initiatives.name: Really Really Free Market Corvallis
initiatives.description: Corvallis free market where people give and take clothes, hygiene items, food, books and other goods at no cost; held on Fridays at Central Park, according to 2021 coverage.

initiatives.name: Western WashCo for Racial Justice (WWRJ)
initiatives.description: An antiracist group in Forest Grove and western Washington County, Oregon, formerly SURJ Forest Grove and now part of the Rural Organizing Project; it holds action meetings, vigils, and local events.

initiatives.name: Rogue Action Center
initiatives.description: Community organization building grassroots power through mutual aid networks, tenant organizing, and solidarity initiatives across Southern Oregon.

initiatives.name: NativeWomanShare
initiatives.description: Takelma- and Indigenous-led land trust and community project in Murphy, Oregon, running a food sovereignty farm, a gathering space, and supply and produce deliveries for Native women and Two-Spirit people.

initiatives.name: Unite Oregon
initiatives.description: Led by people of color, immigrants and refugees, rural communities, and people experiencing poverty, building a unified intercultural movement for justice through community organizing, mutual aid, and leadership development.

initiatives.name: Cascades Abortion Support Collective
initiatives.description: Volunteer-run collective in Portland offering free rides, lodging, meals, emotional support, and aftercare kits to people getting abortions in Oregon, plus free emergency contraception.

initiatives.name: Center for Rural Livelihoods
initiatives.description: A non-profit organization focused on rural development and community supported forestry, offering workforce training, community garden spaces, and educational programs to support sustainable rural communities.

initiatives.name:
Clackamas County
                                Equity
                                Coalition
initiatives.description: A Clackamas County, Oregon coalition that shares newsletters and event calendars, rates candidates on equity, and works on mutual aid, immigrant support, and school board issues.

initiatives.name: Respond to Racism
initiatives.description: Lake Oswego nonprofit working on racism in Clackamas County. Holds monthly community meetings and events, offers learning resources, and campaigns for mandatory ethnic studies in high schools.

initiatives.name: Rural Organizing Project
initiatives.description: A statewide network, founded in 1992, of 85+ local human dignity groups in rural Oregon; it publishes voter guides and hosts an annual Rural Caucus.

initiatives.name: Black Oregon Land Trust
initiatives.description: Black-women-founded community land trust based in Corbett, Oregon. Works to give Black and Indigenous communities secure, affordable land access, with stewardship education and a nature school.

initiatives.name: Civil Liberties Defense Center
initiatives.description: Eugene-based nonprofit law office that gives free legal representation to activists, especially climate and protest defendants, and runs legal trainings.

initiatives.name: Oregon Sex Workers Committee
initiatives.description: Addresses economic and health disparities among consensual adult sex workers and trafficking survivors in Oregon, centering BIPOC communities through research, advocacy, education, and harm reduction to promote safety and equity.

initiatives.name: Oregon Rural
initiatives.description: People organizing for the well-being of our communities and environment.
